tasks.short: Develop innovative technology or train staff for its implementation.

steps.what: Develop and test the actual innovative technology and define its validated implementation procedure
Prepare implementation training material from the validated procedure for the actual staff audience

loop.purpose: Turn the validated procedure into task-specific teaching explanations without inventing a technique.
loop.input: Validated procedure, limits and actual learner tasks.
loop.output: Training draft with source links and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Manager checks every instruction, order, caution, example and learning objective against the validated method and actual staff tasks, not just terminology.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unsupported teaching content returns to the manager.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates provide layout but do not explain unfamiliar scientific steps for this audience.

steps.what: Check and approve the exact completed implementation training material v1 for scientific fidelity and permitted disclosure
Publish the exact approved implementation training material v1 to the named internal staff course
Train staff in the actual implementation, demonstrate the technology and observe their practice
outputs: actual training and observed practice results

steps.what: Enter and check actual attendance and demonstrated practice outcomes after the training in record v1
inputs: actual training and observed practice results

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual training record v1 in the same course record

tasks.design: Use native {LMS} course templates first; add a bounded teaching-draft step over the validated procedure in {DOCS} only for audience-specific explanations. Technology development and live teaching stay human, publication follows review of the completed material, and actual outcomes are recorded after the session.
tasks.previous_blocker: A scientific method does not automatically become understandable staff training.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-constrained draft can rephrase the validated method while the manager checks instructional meaning.
tasks.still_hard: Novel technology, safe implementation and demonstrated competence need real testing and observation.
tasks.human_edge: Judge scientific validity and recognise whether a learner can perform the actual work.

ambition.what: No new technology or competency decision rights.

tasks.altitude: Less training prose drafting, with technology development and practice assessment unchanged.

reach.learn: Keep approved methods, actual training and competence evidence distinct.

evidence.claim: A bounded model can propose teaching prose from an approved method, subject to scientific and instructional review.

assumptions: Boundary includes the manager's technology development contribution and staff training, not all scientists' research time. {OTHER} is the laboratory or scientific development environment. Shares are provisional.

The manager produces validated method steps, equipment context, limits, cautions and actual learner tasks. Missing scientific instructions return to the manager for manual authorship. The manager captures actual attendance and practice results after teaching; enrolment is not completion.
Test native templates first. No savings in experimental work, staff practice, publication or same-record save. No new individual staff scoring is introduced.
unknowns: Real balance between technology development and staff instruction
Permission to process confidential methods in a drafting service
research_questions: Does reviewed teaching prose reduce preparation effort without changing the validated method?

already_counted.description: Source and instruction checks during teaching-draft preparation.
Final scientific and disclosure approval of completed material.

incremental.description: Refresh draft constraints when the method or learner tasks change.

approvals.approved_version: approved implementation training material v1 and named staff course; edits void approval
checked actual training record v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Where training preparation is 20 of 100 task hours, a reviewed source draft removes 8 hours less 1 upkeep. Short methods leave less drafting to remove; technology development, actual teaching and post-training evidence stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Present at professional meetings to further knowledge in the field.

steps.what: Choose the scientific contribution and check actual results, source material and audience needs
Prepare the presentation slides and speaker explanations from the checked scientific argument

loop.purpose: Draft the explanatory narrative around the manager's selected scientific argument.
loop.input: Checked argument, source figures, uncertainty and meeting brief.
loop.output: Slide-text and speaker-note draft with source links.
loop.check: Manager checks every scientific claim, causal implication, qualifier and figure explanation against the sources and intended argument; no invented results or references.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; unresolved scientific claims are manually rewritten.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native slide layouts handle formatting but cannot choose explanatory wording for this scientific audience.

steps.what: Rehearse and check the complete presentation v1 for scientific meaning, timing and exact permitted public disclosure
Deliver the exact approved presentation v1 at the professional meeting and answer questions within the permitted scope

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} presentation layouts, then draft only the explanations around the manager's selected argument and actual source figures. The manager checks scientific meaning and the final disclosure version, rehearses and delivers the presentation personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific explanation for a meeting audience still requires substantial prose drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-constrained drafting can propose wording without deciding the scientific contribution.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing a defensible claim, answering unplanned questions and protecting unpublished results remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Explain uncertainty honestly and answer the question the audience actually asks.

ambition.what: No new publication or disclosure rights.

tasks.altitude: Less first-draft wording; the same scientific authorship and public accountability.

reach.learn: Separate actual results from planned analyses and preserve disclosure limits.

evidence.claim: A bounded source-grounded loop can draft explanatory presentation text for review; this is not a measured presentation case.

assumptions: Boundary covers preparation and actual presentation, not meeting travel or an invented organiser submission. Any distinct slide send must be separately checked and gated if it exists. Shares are provisional.

The manager supplies the scientific argument, actual results, source figures, uncertainties, audience brief and permitted disclosure scope. {OTHER} is the existing scientific results repository. Missing interpretations require manual scientific authorship; no generated data or citations.
Try native layouts first. Full scientific selection, rehearsal, final approval and live delivery retain their time; no automatic public posting.
research_questions: Does a checked draft preserve caveats and reduce rewriting for the real audience?

already_counted.description: Scientific claim and explanation checks while preparing the draft.
Final presentation rehearsal, meaning and disclosure check.

incremental.description: Maintain source permissions and drafting constraints for revised research material.

approvals.approved_version: approved presentation v1 and exact permitted public Q&A scope; changed slides or expanded disclosures require review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A checked explanation draft removes 10.5 of the provisional 30 drafting hours less 1 upkeep. For a short familiar talk little wording is saved; scientific selection, rehearsal and live presentation stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide stewardship of plant, animal or habitat resources through monitoring and care.

steps.what: Review actual habitat, population, land-use and care records to identify the current stewardship situation
Study actual land use, observe plant or animal populations and assess habitat and welfare conditions
Decide the appropriate stewardship response within professional scope and check the exact shelter, resource or qualified-care plan v1
Provide or coordinate the exact checked shelter, resources or qualified animal treatment within authorised professional scope
Write and check actual monitoring and care outcomes after the work in stewardship record v1
Save the exact checked actual stewardship record v1 in the same register

tasks.design: Configure current-record views in the existing habitat and animal-care register {OTHER}, preserving location, observation date and missing-data flags. Actual field study, stewardship decisions and care remain human, and the manager records observed outcomes only after the work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant historical observations and care records can require separate register queries.
tasks.enabler_now: Native location, population and case views can gather existing records.
tasks.still_hard: A record does not establish current welfare or an appropriate treatment.
tasks.human_edge: Judge actual field conditions and obtain qualified care when needed.

ambition.what: No new medical, conservation or land-use authority.

tasks.altitude: Less historical lookup, with field and care responsibilities unchanged.

reach.learn: Preserve location, season and observation uncertainty.

evidence.claim: Native register views can reduce lookup of existing stewardship records without replacing field observation.

assumptions: This provisional mixed task describes the manager's own stewardship work, not all field staff or veterinary labour. Specialist treatment remains with the qualified professional and its time receives no saving credit. No treatment advice is generated.

Existing field staff or the manager produce observation id, location, date, species or animal id, observed counts/condition and actual completed care events. The focal person manually captures new field and care facts here. Missing historical fields require manual lookup; planned care and estimated population are not actual outcomes.

Test native views first. Physical work, current observation capture, care decisions, actual records and same-system save stay full. Any separate order, referral or external report needs its own gate if added.
unknowns: Actual stewardship mix and professional scope
Historical register coverage and query capabilities
research_questions: Does a native current-record view reduce history retrieval while displaying stale observations clearly?

already_counted.description: Capture and check actual post-work stewardship outcomes.

incremental.description: Maintain location and population view definitions after register changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked stewardship response v1 within authorised professional scope; changed action or condition requires reassessment
checked actual stewardship record v1; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native record views remove 5 of the provisional 20 history-review hours, less 1 upkeep. For sparse historical records there is little lookup to remove; field observation, judgement, care and actual recording remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise or assist with patents and other legal requirements.

steps.what: Gather actual invention evidence, contribution history and scientific documents requested for the patent or compliance matter
Discuss the actual technology, contributions and uncertainties with the legal specialist and assist in answering their scientific questions
outputs: actual scientific advice and unresolved legal questions

steps.what: Write the scientific disclosure or requirement response with actual supporting evidence and named uncertainties
inputs: actual scientific advice and unresolved legal questions

steps.what: Check the exact completed scientific response v1, attachments and intended recipient against confidentiality and disclosure instructions
Send the exact approved scientific response package v1 to the named authorised legal specialist

tasks.design: Configure matter tags and a scientific disclosure template in {DOCS}, linking the actual invention evidence already held in {PROJECT}. The manager supplies scientific content and uncertainty, checks the final response and sends that exact package to the authorised specialist; no patentability judgement or filing is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scientific evidence can be scattered across experiment and project folders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native matter metadata and linked templates can reduce retrieval and repeated headings.
tasks.still_hard: Inventive contribution, disclosure boundaries and legal strategy require the responsible people.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what was actually invented and which claims the science cannot support.

ambition.what: No new legal or filing authority.

tasks.altitude: Less evidence retrieval and document setup; scientific accountability stays the same.

reach.learn: Keep contribution and evidence provenance visible to the legal specialist.

evidence.claim: Native matter metadata and document templates can reduce scientific evidence retrieval and repeated formatting.

assumptions: Boundary is scientific assistance, including its written response and actual send to an external authorised adviser. Counsel's legal advice and formal filings remain outside and receive no saving credit. Shares are provisional, not measured.

Research staff produce actual invention records, dates, contributors, versions and source results; the specialist supplies the requested fields, authorised recipient and disclosure instructions. The manager manually resolves missing scientific evidence; dates and contributors are not inferred.

Test native metadata and templates first. Only lookup and repeated headings shrink; scientific prose, consultation, final check and actual send retain full effort. If the adviser is internal, classify the send as write_internal instead.
unknowns: Existing evidence tagging and disclosure template
Internal versus external adviser and permitted disclosure scope
research_questions: Which evidence searches repeat across matters without reusing confidential material across access boundaries?

already_counted.description: Completed package, scientific meaning, recipient and confidentiality check.

incremental.description: Maintain matter metadata and template fields as specialist requirements change.

approvals.approved_version: approved scientific response package v1 including exact attachments, recipient and disclosure scope; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Where native tags remove 9 evidence-search hours and the template removes 2.5 repeated-heading hours per 100 task hours, net is 10.5 after 1 upkeep. A well-organised matter has less repetition; live advice, scientific content, final check and send stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated preparation while scientific, welfare and disclosure judgements remain with responsible professionals.
reach: Give implementation colleagues and legal advisers traceable scientific evidence.
skills_to_grow: Manage source access and disclosure versions
role.ambitious_version: A science manager who prepares clearer reviewed training and presentations without automating scientific or legal authority.
